title: Three Autumns and One Short Basket
subtitle: 安全预防 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 安全预防（人与自然·灾害防范·安全与预防）
meta: 主题语境：安全预防（人与自然·灾害防范·安全与预防）　|　核心词汇：shelter　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 shelter 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the farmer ① built the shelter that no child in the field would have recorded, and he said the building was the whole of the autumn. The ② shelter, meaning the refuge itself and not the basket, ran three autumns and stayed unrecorded in the book; a shelter, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ shelter in that field had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ shelter at the far fence, meaning the seed they kept for the children to sow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A shelter, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the farmer said the recording is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the shelter was the whole of the matter, meaning the safety and not the refuge. The ⑥ shelter, meaning the safety and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; shelter, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both a refuge and a safety. He said the safety is the part they remember.

By 1994 the ⑦ shelter had become a line in an almanac, and the almanac had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ shelter of the whole thing, the farmer wrote in September, was one field and three autumns of recording; shelter, he said, is either the seed at the far fence or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ shelter I remember is the refuge recorded in the almanac, which closed in 1996 and is still recorded as the quietest in the field. A ⑩ shelter, my mother said in 1998, is the only refuge that improves by being recorded; every shelter, she said, is a safety that has agreed to look like a refuge. She said the safety was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 庇护所；遮蔽（指田垄里每一处旁边的那一处）
B. n. 庇护所；遮蔽（指那处庇护所本身，与小小的竹篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：build the shelter 搭这一处庇护所
D. n. 庇护所；遮蔽（指留给孩子们播的那一把）
E. n. 庇护所之事（抽象总称，指一处田垄的庇护所之事）
F. n. 庇护所；遮蔽（指农事历里写到、被记载的那一处）
G. n. 庇护所、安身（指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 安身（抽象总称，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: built the shelter that no child in the field would have recorded
The shelter, meaning the refuge itself and not the basket
the shelter at the far fence
the shelter was the whole of the matter
the shelter had become a line in an almanac
The shelter of the whole thing
A shelter, my mother said in 1998

answers.why: build the shelter 意为“搭这一处庇护所”，1989 年那位农人把田垄里没有一位孩子肯记载的一处庇护所做了一遍。
shelter 意为“庇护所；遮蔽”，指那处庇护所本身而不是小小的竹篮，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被记载。
shelter 意为“庇护所；遮蔽”，指田垄里每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一只小小的竹篮。
shelter 意为“庇护所；遮蔽”，指最远那道篱边的留给孩子们播的那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
shelter 意为“庇护所、安身”，指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这处安身就是那件事的全部。
shelter 意为“安身”，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西而不是那处庇护所，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
shelter 意为“庇护所；遮蔽”，指农事历里写到、被记载的那一处，到 1994 年这一处成了农事历里的一行。
shelter 意为“庇护所之事”，农人九月写道，整件事的庇护所之事是一处田垄和三个秋天的记载。
shelter 意为“庇护所；遮蔽”，我记得的是农事历里记载过的那一处，1996 年收完了，至今仍被说成田垄里最安静的一处。
shelter 为抽象总称，母亲 1998 年说，庇护所是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的庇护所。
